name: Fret
author: Erin Carter
description: A Greek-key meander engraved as a continuous border around the frame, its center left deep and empty. The engraving never moves — a small specular glint travels the closed rectilinear path, cornering crisply and trailing a soft afterglow, like a coin tilted under lamplight.

params.label: Run speed
params.effect: Multiplies the glint's pace around the border circuit; 0 parks a single lit corner, 2 sends it racing a full lap every few seconds.

params.label: Key size
params.effect: Size of each Greek-key cell in CSS pixels — a fine dense meander at the minimum, a bold architectural border at the maximum.

params.label: Tail length
params.effect: Length of the fading afterglow behind the glint as a fraction of the circuit; 0 is a bare point of light, 0.5 leaves half the border softly embered behind it.
